reproduced_defect: V8/V9 ordering correctly makes the durable response the source of truth before memory-only state, but a restart loses ForegroundAccountReservations. Replaying a persisted tool call without rebuilding its reservation can expose the call to Codex while the persisted owner account is no longer protected across the local tool gap. The inverse also matters: a persisted final response must clear any stale reservation before output.
required_invariant: On durable replay hit, derive post-commit ephemeral state from the persisted record before any identity-bearing HTTP/SSE output: tool-call response => reserve persisted account for the turn; final response => clear stale reservation. Then rebuild optional memory cache. If ephemeral reconstruction fails, return an error without another provider call; retry may reconstruct again from durable state.
